buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid.

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. Scope of Consultancy Services The selected Consultant shall be required to undertake the following services: · Site inspection and verification of existing measurements and site conditions. · Space planning and concept design, including preparation and submission of 3D views/presentations for c onsideration and approval of the Institute. · Preparation of detailed design and working drawings, including architectural, electrical, HVAC, IT and othe r relevant services drawings, as applicable. · Preparation of detailed technical specifications and Bill of Quantities (BoQ). · Periodic site supervision during execution of the works and providing necessary design-related clarificatio ns, as required. · The detailed scope, deliverables, timelines and other requirements shall be specified in the Terms of Refe rence (ToR)/Request for Proposal (RFP). B. Eligibility and Qualification Requirements The Consultant/Bidder shall meet the following minimum eligibility requirements: · The firm shall have demonstrated experience in interior fit-out/interior design consultancy works of a simil ar nature and scale. · The firm shall have satisfactorily completed similar consultancy assignments/works as specified in the RF P. · The firm shall have an adequately qualified and experienced key professional team, including at least one qualified Architect and an MEP professional/consultant, commensurate with the requirements of the assign ment. · The firm shall possess all applicable statutory registrations, licences and compliances required for undert aking the assignment. An undertaking must be submitted by the bidder. · The detailed eligibility and qualification criteria shall be incorporated in the RFP and shall be relevant and proportionate to the requirements of the consultancy assignment. C. Buyer added bid specific specifications, terms and conditions shall apply to this bid.
